message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 24 November 2026, 23:40 UTC to 25 November 2026, 23:40 UTC (26 November, 05:10 IST). **Scope:** Products.txt only, normalized and deduplicated, plus the required MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

New relevant advisories were found for Ubuntu and MongoDB ecosystem components. The critical MongoDB C Driver issue warrants prompt review where the component is deployed.

**MongoDB C Driver: CVE-2026-135224**
**Severity:** Critical, CVSS 3.1 9.1. The driver may accept a revoked certificate because it does not verify that the signer of a certificate-status response is authorized. An attacker operating the TLS endpoint could expose database traffic. This is an official MongoDB driver; relevance depends on its use in the environment. Affected ranges are 1.18.0 to before 1.30.17 and 2.0.0 to before 2.5.10. [National Cybersecurity Institute record](https://nki.gov.hu/figyelmeztetesek/serulekenysegek/cve-2026-135224/).

**MongoDB Python Driver: CVE-2026-135898**
**Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 8.2. Crafted BSON supplied to the native decoder can terminate the application and, in some configurations, expose limited process memory in errors. This affects an official MongoDB driver, not necessarily MongoDB Server itself. The CVE record lists versions 1.9.0 to before 4.20.2. [Rapid7 record](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-135898/).

**MongoDB C Driver: CVE-2026-135134**
**Severity:** Medium, CVSS 3.1 5.9; High, CVSS 4.0 8.2. A malicious server endpoint or a party able to alter unencrypted traffic may send a crafted discovery response that terminates the client application. This affects the official MongoDB C Driver; check the listed version ranges. [CVE record mirror](https://db.gcve.eu/vuln/cve-2026-135134).

**MongoDB C Driver: CVE-2026-135222**
**Severity:** Low, CVSS 2.0, as reported in CVSS 4.0. A process-wide AWS credential cache can take precedence over credentials specified for an individual connection, potentially causing authentication under an unintended identity. This concerns applications using the MongoDB C Driver and its AWS authentication. [C Driver advisory summary](https://watcher.digitalizingworld.com/batch/2026-11-25-mongodb-c-driver-18f78f.html).

**MongoDB libmongocrypt: CVE-2026-135223**
**Severity:** Medium, CVSS 3.1 4.3. Repeated fields in encryption key documents can cause application memory consumption to grow. This applies to MongoDB's encryption support library when used by an application, not automatically to every MongoDB installation. The CVE record lists versions 1.0.0 to before 1.21.2. [CVE record mirror](https://db.gcve.eu/vuln/cve-2026-135223).

**MongoDB integration for Laravel: CVE-2026-135145**
**Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 8.1. A relationship query can fail to apply an application's intended access restriction, potentially allowing a low-privileged user to read or change protected records. This is relevant where the official MongoDB Laravel integration is used; its presence is not established by the product list. [CVE record search](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/search?apply_sort=0&assigner=&date_sort=published&ft_q=&fulltext=0&page=1&page_size=30&product=&sort_order=desc&sort_sources=avid&sort_sources=certfr_alerte&sort_sources=certfr_avis&sort_sources=csaf&sort_sources=cvelistv5&sort_sources=fkie_nvd&sort_sources=github&sort_sources=gna-1&sort_sources=gna-128&sort_sources=gna-1337&sort_sources=gna-1988&sort_sources=jvndb&sort_sources=moksha&sort_sources=nvd&sort_sources=pysec&sort_sources=variot&vendor=MongoDB).

**Ubuntu Kerberos: USN-9202-1**
**Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice. Canonical's new advisory covers multiple Kerberos issues, including denial of service, security restriction bypass and other impacts, in packages for Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 LTS. Ubuntu is directly monitored; affected packages and conditions vary by CVE. This is a new distribution advisory, not a claim that each underlying CVE was first disclosed today. [Canonical advisory](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9202-1).

**Possible matches needing review**
MongoDB-assigned CVE-2026-135144 and CVE-2026-135142 were indexed as affecting the Laravel MongoDB integration, but the individual descriptions and severity could not be adequately verified in this run. Confirm the official records and whether the integration is installed. [CVE index](https://cvefocus.com/latest-cves).

**Closing:** Prioritize assessment of the critical C Driver certificate issue and the high-severity driver and integration findings against actual deployed components. Review the Ubuntu advisory for installed versions and packages. The dedicated MongoDB sweep included the vendor alert index and searches for Server, mongod/mongos, Atlas, management services, Compass, mongosh, tools, operators, drivers, connectors, integrations and vendor-assigned CVEs; search indexing and inaccessible records limit completeness.
